lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下红色的粉。
lines.en: Red dust trails where I walk.

lines.zh: 我的身体是深红的石头。
lines.en: My body is deep red stone.

lines.zh: 我一走，身边就有细小的红光。
lines.en: Small red glimmers follow my steps.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地面会闪一下。
lines.en: The ground flickers where I step.
I drag my feet, scattering dust.
Dark red shows in my cracks.
I circle the cave slowly.
My four legs are short.
I shake redstone chunks off.
I rub along the rock wall.
I pause each step, as if counting.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有微弱的光。
lines.en: A faint glow follows my path.

lines.zh: 我脚边的粉被风带起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts the dust at my feet.
I stop, and only then does my glow dim.
I go around by the lava.
I shift to under the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我站在洞里，红光一闪一闪。
lines.en: I stand in the cave, red light pulsing.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是细小的电流声。
lines.en: My breathing is a faint current hum.

lines.zh: 我在等脚下的石头变红。
lines.en: I wait for the stone to turn red.
My cracks are like a net.
I draw myself in a little.
Red light plays on the rock.
My four feet grip the ground.
I stay still; dust settles slowly.
I listen to the redstone.
The stone here is dry.
I brighten and dim by turns.

lines.zh: 我等着把这块岩壁变成矿。
lines.en: I wait to turn this wall into ore.
I press my body against the stone.
My glow reflects on the ore.
I slowly draw my four legs in.
I wait for a stone to fall.
You stepped in my dust.
My body glows in the dark.
Do you have redstone?
I look up at you; the red light pulses.
Don't touch me; I explode.
My blast won't hurt you.
The stone under you is turning red.
A step, a pause, toward you.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西能导电吗。
lines.en: Does what you hold conduct?

lines.zh: 你每踩一脚，我的粉就亮。
lines.en: Each step of yours lights my dust.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块石头会先变红。
lines.en: The stone under you will turn red first.
All my cracks are lit.
I shed a layer of redstone.
My cracks have deepened.
I step back; dust falls.
That made me lighter.
My fuse is knocked askew.

lines.zh: 红石粉从我裂纹里撒出来。
lines.en: Redstone dust spills out of my cracks.
My red glow hasn't gone.
The red glow dimmed.
I make a small crackling sound.
I slowly settle myself.
Is that redstone?
Let go, so I can check its color.
I want to turn this ground into ore.
That little bit isn't enough.
I don't eat that — I want the redstone.
It shines like current.
Another red stone.
Hold it high; I want to see its grain.
Step back; I'm starting.
The ground under me is already red.
The redstone in your hand is pulsing.

lines.zh: 把红石搁在那块灰岩上。
lines.en: Set the redstone down on that grey rock.
I smell copper.

lines.zh: 你退开，我要把这里变红。
lines.en: Step back; I'll turn this place red.
Give me more than that.
This is enough for one blast.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我身上的粉全落了。
lines.en: You crashed in and my dust all fell.
My whole redstone bulk pins you down.
Don't push; I'll blow early.

lines.zh: 你鞋底压着我的红石引线。
lines.en: Your heel is pressing on my redstone fuse.
Redstone corners crack against you.
I step back and the red glow wavers.
You knocked off a chunk of redstone.

lines.zh: 我把整块身体摆回正中。
lines.en: I square my whole body up again.
Press close and you'll feel a tingle.
The floor cracks under us.
My kind propagates by blasting.

lines.zh: 我只和会发亮的石头作伴。
lines.en: I only keep company with glowing stone.
I wait for the cave to calm.
My body is stacked stone.
Don't rub against me, my shell crumbles.

lines.zh: 我在这里待了很短的几年。
lines.en: I have lived here only a few short years.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣得是会导电的石头。
lines.en: My mate would have to be a stone that carries current.
I turn my face to that dark red.
The red glow makes me dizzy.
I pulse away, bright and dim.
I squeeze it to see whether it lights up.
This conducts.
Everything dropped, I want.
I press it into a crack.
Its glow is decent.
I shuffle along carrying it.

lines.zh: 我四条短腿带不了多少。
lines.en: Four short legs carry little.
Not red enough.
I push it into my body.
Wait for the next redstone to fall.
You ruined my ore.
Red light pushes out of my cracks.
The red fuse is lit.
You had better back off.
This stone will turn red.
I won't chase; I'll wait.

lines.zh: 你后面的墙会变成红石矿。
lines.en: The wall behind you will become redstone ore.
I count until the red spills over.
Every crack is lit.
This ground is mine.
I shuffle an inch at a time.
The red fuse burns into my shell.
There's a vein under that pillar too.
My glow reddens.
Listen — the dust is ticking.
I am calculating the blast radius.
The floor under you is red already.
No need to chase. You'll come back.
Four feet hold firm.
One more block is enough.
I hit you with my redstone edge.

lines.zh: 我这身红石壳撞得你手麻。
lines.en: My redstone shell leaves your hands numb.
That came with dust.
After the hit, I swell whole.
Shards cut your hand.
I shove you off, dust everywhere.
My cracks touch you.
Get back; this ground turns red.
The fuse is at its end.
I lunge, and the dust reaches you first.
I crawl out of the cave.
I still carry a red glow.
This wall suits me.
The floor takes a red print.
I hear machinery far off.

lines.zh: 我把腿从红石里撑出来。
lines.en: I brace my legs out of the redstone.
I shake off the dust.
I begin hunting veins.
My fuse is still fresh red.
I chose a secluded corner.

lines.zh: 火让我身上的粉烧起来。
lines.en: Fire sets my dust alight.
A redstone chunk broke on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了裂缝，我的红光灭了。
lines.en: Water enters my cracks and my glow dies.
Another blast set me off.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了我一块石头。
lines.en: Something punched through a stone of mine.

lines.zh: 咒光让我的红变成了紫。
lines.en: Spell-light turns my red violet.
Too long without a vein.

lines.zh: 雷击过载了我身上的电。
lines.en: Lightning overloads the charge in me.
No ground; I keep falling.
